rows.en: "Flag 1B0 has not been set. To play this private
event, set flag 1B0 and try again.
Otherwise, the event will be forcibly terminated."<FC:B4:3E>
Yamato: "Huh? The elevator's moving. That's unusual.
Is someone riding it, I wonder?"
Touya: "Of course people ride it."
Yamato: "But whenever I see it, it's stopped.
Right on that floor, too."
Touya: "You're imagining it. Imagining it. Anyway..."
Yamato: "Oh, it stopped."
Fain: "Hahahahaha!
To protect my beloved, the blade of justice strikes the enemy!
With red blood burning crimson, that is a man's way of life!
A man of justice and truth!
Faaain, Jiiin, Baaaarion!!
I make my entrance! For justice... I can die!"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "..."
Touya: "..."
Fain: "Aaah!"
Fain: "H-Hey! Don't ignore me!
I went to the trouble of waiting for you..."
Touya: "...You should have Gabon examine you sometime."
Fain: "What?! I am health itself!
I'm not so feeble that I'd fall ill!
Dahahahaha!"
Yamato: "...It's a serious case."
Fain: "...So, how was it? I'm pretty confident
about this one. Ah, my own talent frightens me."
It's pretty good, isn't it?
It's like enka.
Fain: "Isn't it? That last part, especially!
It thrills even me when I say it."
Yamato: "He's drunk on himself... It's terminal."
Touya: "R-Right. Well, keep at it."
Fain: "'Enka'? What's that?"
Yamato: "Hmm... Perhaps something like 'a song of the Japanese
heart'?"
Fain: "Heart? So it's a song that resonates
directly with the soul?"
Yamato: "W-Well, something like that."
Fain: "Oh! So my proclamation is just that
wonderful!"
Yamato: "Y-Yeah... Maybe..."
Fain: "Dahahahaha! You understand!"
Yamato: "By the way, Fain, why are you so
straightforward?"
Fain: "Heh heh heh... Because I believe in justice!
To die for it would be my greatest wish!
And that justice is also to protect the people dear to me!"
Touya: "Huh. People dear to you, eh..."
Fain: "Yes! For the princess, for Miss Ymir,
and for K-Kasumi... No! My justice is not
so fickle! Oh, what am I to do...?"
Yamato: "...What do we do?"
Touya: "We'd better keep away..."
Fain: "We're friends, aren't we?!
Tell me, who am I supposed to fight for?
I've resolved in my heart to love only one woman.
But I also bear the noble and supreme
duty of protecting the princess. I can't forsake either loyalty or love.
Ah... What an ordeal! This is a knight's destiny!
Then I shall press on! To fight fate!
No, wait. But wanting too much at once
is the same as losing everything, my master said.
Does that mean I must see one choice or the other through?!
Oh! How can this be?!
And choosing between Miss Ymir and Kasumi...
Damn it! This is all because those ≪Ze=Ode≫ bastards...
If it weren't for them, I wouldn't have had to suffer
like this...
Wait! Could this be their conspiracy?!
Grrrrr! Damn them... How despicable...
No, how fearsome ≪Ze=Ode≫ is!
But I, Fain Jin Barion, won't let a little thing like that
break my spirit! Hmm? Does that mean,
to turn their scheme against them, I must preserve my love for two women
and my loyalty to the princess
all at the same time?
No, but that would go against my master's teaching.
Aaaah! What am I supposed to doooo?!"
Fain: "...Huh? Touya? Heeey..."
Yamato: "...He has it rough too."
Touya: "Well, he seems to find it fulfilling in his own way.
Anyway, let's go."
Yamato: "Y-Yeah..."
Yamato: "Huh? Fain's signal disappeared..."
Fain: "Heh heh heh heh heh..."
Touya: "Hey, Yamato. He's over there."
Yamato: "Oh, isn't that Dusseldorf?
Hmm... Fain's rubbing his cheek against it..."
Touya: "He's just that happy, isn't he?"
Fain: "My Spirit Mech!
Heh, heh heh heh heh..."
Yamato: "Shall we leave him alone for now?"
Touya: "Yeah..."
